general.env.lead: Read-only. Change it in the compose file, then restart.
general.env.title: Set through the environment

general.env_invalid_backups: :env holds a value this setting does not accept. tesserarr:migrate refuses to run until it is fixed or removed.
general.hint.backups_keep: Default 5, from 1 to 50. tesserarr:migrate keeps this many.
general.hint.display_name: Shown in the header and on the sign-in page.

general.overridden: Overridden by the environment. Set through :env. Remove it to edit here.

tokens.empty.body: A token you create shows up here, with when it was last used and when it expires.

tokens.failed: The token could not be issued. Try again.
tokens.invalid.expiry: The expiry must lie in the future.
tokens.invalid.name: Give the token a name of 1 to 100 characters, without control characters.
tokens.invalid.owner: You can create tokens only for yourself.
tokens.issued_lead: Copy it now. Afterwards Tesserarr keeps only its hash and cannot show it again.
tokens.lead: For your own scripts and tools. The interface itself needs no token.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.name_hint: What the token is for, for example the script that uses it.
